Machine Learning.description: Machine Learning is a branch of Artificial Intelligence.
Machine Learning.reference_text: Machine Learning is a branch of Artificial Intelligence that enables computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. It uses algorithms to recognize patterns, make predictions, and improve performance through experience.

Cloud Computing.description: Cloud Computing provides computing services over the internet.
Cloud Computing.reference_text: Cloud Computing is the delivery of computing services including servers, storage, databases, networking, and software over the Internet. It provides scalability, flexibility, and cost-effective access to computing resources.

Artificial Intelligence.reference_text: Artificial Intelligence is the simulation of human intelligence in machines. AI enables systems to learn, reason, solve problems, understand language, and make decisions similarly to humans.

Data Science.description: Data Science extracts insights from data.
Data Science.reference_text: Data Science combines statistics, machine learning, programming, and domain knowledge to analyze data, discover patterns, and support decision-making.

Operating System.description: Operating System manages hardware and software.
Operating System.reference_text: An Operating System is system software that manages computer hardware, software resources, memory, processes, files, and provides an interface between users and the computer.
